name: Demandbase
description:
Demandbase integration with Claude gives sales, marketing, and GTM teams seamless access to rich B2B data directly inside Claude for easier account targeting and engagement. 

This app connects Claude to Demandbase via a secure MCP connection, letting you access both first and third party data:
Third-Party Data (3P): Search and retrieve industry-leading company and contact data from Demandbase, including firmographics, technographics, family tree, company news, and leadership profiles.
First-Party Data (1P): Securely access your own Demandbase 1P data such as known accounts, contacts, CRM entities, engagement, and in-pipeline opportunities, including intent signals and buying-group data.

Account Brief: Generate a single, consolidated account overview combining engagement state, opportunities, buying-group coverage, intent signals, company profile, and news in one call.

What you can do:
Search companies by name, location, size, revenue, or industry
Discover decision-makers and influencers by role or job level
Fetch full company profiles including recent news and competitors
Tap into 1P signals like engagement, MQA status, or activity
Identify buying intent on specific topics or keyword sets, this week or over time
Find net-new buying-group contacts at an account that aren't already in your CRM
Pull a full account brief in a single call for fast call prep

Who it's for:
Sales reps looking for fast answers about a target account in real time
Marketers enriching leads or refining personas
RevOps and Enablement teams embedding intelligence into workflows
AI product teams creating agent workflows

Availability:
This integration is available to Demandbase customers with the appropriate Demandbase licenses and entitlements. To request access, please contact your Demandbase Customer Success Manager (CSM). For technical support, contact support@demandbase.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Demandbase to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Demandbase to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://gateway.demandbase.com/mcp/servers/db-mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Demandbase MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Demandbase provides these MCP tools: account_brief, company_global_directory, contact_global_directory, get_demandbase_reference_data, search_internal_account_database, and search_internal_person_database.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Demandbase?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Demandbase in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Demandbase requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Demandbase is developed by Demandbase. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
